survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note summarizes system-level indicators for Estonia using the latest available reference year(s) from Education at a Glance 2025. The document does not provide student-level microdata or an explicit analytic sample definition, nor does it report any use of complex survey weights or replicate-weight procedures. Instead, it reports descriptive comparisons (e.g., attainment gaps, unemployment rates by educational attainment, literacy proficiency shares) and points readers to the corresponding Education at a Glance 2025 tables and the Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes for indicator-specific collection and estimation methods. For replication at the indicator level, analysts should consult the referenced technical notes (and the OECD Handbook for Internationally Comparative Education Statistics) to identify the exact weighting, scaling, and estimation approach used for each indicator.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a descriptive OECD country note that reports indicator results (e.g., attainment shares, unemployment rates, literacy proficiency levels) rather than estimating student-level models with plausible values (PVs). PV handling is therefore not applicable because no PV-based achievement modeling is described in the note. Missing-data handling is not reported because the note does not provide the underlying microdata processing or indicator-specific imputation/deletion procedures; those are deferred to the Education at a Glance 2025 Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes.

data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025 (Estonia country note) provides a descriptive overview of education-system characteristics, with emphasis on tertiary education, using the latest available reference-year data compiled in Education at a Glance 2025. The note reports cross-sectional indicator comparisons such as intergenerational tertiary-attainment gaps (e.g., 64% vs 17% for parental tertiary vs non-upper-secondary attainment), unemployment rates by educational attainment, and literacy proficiency distributions from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC). It also summarizes tertiary participation and progression indicators (entry routes, gender composition, field-of-study shares, completion and dropout patterns) and education-finance and workforce indicators (expenditure per student, teacher turnover, teacher salary ratios, instructional time and class size). No student-level predictive modeling, plausible values estimation, or ML evaluation is conducted in the note; methodological details for each indicator are provided via the linked Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction corresponds to an OECD descriptive country note rather than an empirical large-scale assessment analysis with an ML pipeline. As a result, there is no reported student-level dataset, no analytic sample size, no PV or missing-data strategy for an ML model, and no ML algorithms or performance metrics to extract. The note instead synthesizes indicator results and points to the underlying Education at a Glance 2025 tables and technical documentation for the indicator-specific estimation methodology.
